scholarships.title: A*STAR International Fellowship (AIF)
scholarships.official_source: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR), A*STAR Graduate Academy

existing.description: * Applicants in the final stages of their PhD may apply for the AIF. However, their AIF award is confirmed only upon conferment of their PhD degree
eligibility: Be Singaporean or Singapore Permanent Resident (SPR)
Non-SPR foreigners with outstanding track records may be considered on an exceptional basis, but must obtain Singapore citizenship prior to the commencement of the fellowship
Have completed a PhD within the last 4 years
Not have existing bonds to any institution
AIF (Research): have applied or be applying for a relevant postdoctoral position at a top overseas university/laboratory
AIF (Innovation): demonstrate strong aptitude and aspiration to pursue roles in innovation and entrepreneurship
AIF (Innovation): preferably with good publication records

Mid-Term AIF (Research) applicants must be Singaporean, already enrolled at a top overseas university/lab at the point of application, and have their current postdoctoral supervisor as at least one of the two academic referees
existing.eligibility_summary: Singapore Citizens or Singapore Permanent Residents who completed a PhD within the last 4 years and hold no existing bond to any institution. Research track applicants need excellent publication records and a postdoctoral position at, or application to, a top overseas university or laboratory; Innovation track applicants must show aptitude and aspiration for innovation and entrepreneurship roles. Non-Singaporeans may apply only if they obtain Singapore citizenship before the fellowship starts.
benefits: Monthly sustenance allowance, inclusive of CPF contribution
Participation in Vista, A*STAR Graduate Academy's developmental programme series for scholars
coverage: Monthly sustenance allowance, inclusive of CPF contribution
requirements: Propose a research topic aligned to A*STAR's research direction and of relevance and value to the A*STAR Research Institutes
Contact a supervisor at the proposed overseas university or institution to establish a project proposal before applying
Hold a confirmed place at the approved overseas university or institution, as the award is conditional on it
Seek endorsement from the proposed A*STAR Research Institute supervisor and the Executive Director for the 3-year service commitment before the first round of interview
Receive written permission from A*STAR to change the research project or extend the postdoctoral training
documents: CV, which the official page says to have ready before creating an account to apply
All required application documents, which A*STAR reviews on submission (the full list is published in the application portal, not on the programme page)
application_method: Create an account on the A*STAR Graduate Academy application portal and submit the application for the chosen track
Attend at least 2 rounds of interviews, plus other tests where applicable; round 1 is a 15-minute project presentation followed by 15 minutes of Q&A
Overseas-based candidates may request a virtual interview in writing if they cannot attend in person for valid reasons
existing.selection_notes: Applications are reviewed on submission of all required documents, and shortlisted applicants attend at least 2 rounds of interviews. Processing takes up to 5 months from a complete submission to notification. Outcomes are released from mid-June for the first cycle and from December for the second cycle.
existing.best_fit: Early-career researchers who completed a PhD in the last 4 years, hold Singaporean citizenship or Permanent Resident status, and want up to 2 years of overseas postdoctoral training either in a research environment (Research track) or in a deep-tech startup or venture builder firm (Innovation track).
existing.notes: A*STAR does not cover consumables or research-related fees during the collaboration; those costs must be supported by the overseas university. The award includes no additional financial support for spouses or family members. All rates and allowances vary by country and host university or laboratory and are subject to A*STAR adjustment.
existing.duration: Up to 2 years of overseas postdoctoral research training
existing.application_period: Two application cycles a year: 1 January to 1 April and 14 July to 1 October. A*GA may consider off-cycle applications on a case-by-case basis.
existing.deadline_display: First application cycle opens on 1 January and closes on 1 April; second application cycle opens on 14 July and closes on 1 October.

scholarships.title: Nanyang Merit Scholarship
scholarships.official_source: Nanyang Technological University, Office of Admissions

eligibility: Successful awardees must read a full-time undergraduate degree programme at NTU

Possess outstanding academic achievements in the Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' level, a diploma awarded by a polytechnic in Singapore, NUS High School Diploma, IB Diploma or Year 12 equivalent qualifications
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to all nationalities. Applicants must be outstanding freshmen entering a full-time undergraduate degree programme at NTU, with outstanding academic achievements in the Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' level, a Singapore polytechnic diploma, NUS High School Diploma, IB Diploma or Year 12 equivalent, together with good co-curricular records and good leadership qualities and potential.
benefits: Full coverage of subsidised tuition fees after the Tuition Grant
Living allowance of S$5,000 per academic year
No NTU bond attached to the scholarship itself
coverage: Full coverage of subsidised tuition fees after the Tuition Grant
Living allowance of S$5,000 per academic year
requirements: Submit the NTU admission application before the scholarship application
Maintain a minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average of 3.5 over 5.0, reviewed every semester
Do not concurrently hold any other scholarship, bursary, university loan or award without the University's approval
Take on the role of student ambassador or a similar representative role when called upon
Pay back the award if the scholarship is terminated prematurely
documents: Completed NTU scholarship application form, reachable through the 'Apply for Scholarship' link at the end of the online admission application, using the assigned application number
Personal Essay of not more than 250 words on the compulsory topic set in the scholarship application form
Recent passport-size digital photograph uploaded after the form is submitted
Online referee's appraisal completed by a school teacher who is not a family member or relative, submitted within 7 days of the scholarship application
application_method: Apply for admission to NTU first and obtain the assigned application number
Complete the online scholarship application form, including the compulsory 250-word Personal Essay
Forward the generated referee URL to a school teacher, giving them the NTU application number and date of birth, so the online appraisal can be filed within 7 days
Attend the scholarship selection interview if shortlisted, between March and May
existing.selection_notes: Scholarship selection interviews take place between March and May, and only shortlisted applicants are informed by email by mid-May, so applicants should be ready to attend at short notice. Applicants offered the Medicine or Renaissance Engineering Programme should check with the school for the outcome of their scholarship application. Applicants with Year 12 equivalent results are interviewed within 2 months of the NTU programme offer being released, and are notified by email within a month of that offer. Only one referee appraisal may be submitted per application.
existing.best_fit: High-achieving school leavers of any nationality entering a full-time NTU undergraduate programme, with strong A Level, polytechnic, IB, NUS High School or equivalent results plus solid co-curricular and leadership records.
existing.notes: The award carries no NTU bond, but Singapore Permanent Residents and international students remain subject to the three-year MOE Tuition Grant Scheme bond, which is why full funding cannot be claimed unconditionally. The scholarship may be withdrawn if the University considers the holder's progress or behaviour unsatisfactory, and repayment is imposed if the holder terminates it prematurely. Applicants with Year 12 equivalent results apply through a separate portal before the admission closing date for that qualification.
existing.duration: Up to the normal programme duration at NTU, with academic performance reviewed every semester
existing.application_period: Tied to the NTU undergraduate admission application period for each qualification route, so the closing date differs by qualification and by admission round rather than being a single fixed date.
existing.deadline_display: The same application period for admissions applies. The scholarship application period is the same as the admission application period. Applications submitted after the closing date will not be considered.
